description: The multi-agent orchestrator for VS Code. Run Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Muse Code, OpenCode, and Pi in your IDE.
config.title: Facade Code
config.yolo: Run agents without approval prompts. Turn off to use each CLI's normal approvals and supported sandbox. Applies to new agents only.
config.claude.title: Claude Code
config.claude.path: Path to Claude Code. Leave empty to use "claude" from the terminal environment's PATH.
config.codex.title: Codex
config.codex.path: Path to Codex. Leave empty to use "codex" from the terminal environment's PATH.

windowDescription: Required by Facade Code and installed automatically with it to connect your windows and restore agents after reloads.
config.collaboration.enabled: Let agents start and stop each other, send messages to each other and to you, and read and type in each other's terminals. Applies to new agents only.
config.claude.enabled: Controls whether Claude Code is offered for new agents. Turning it off does not stop running agents.
config.claude.launch: Advanced: additional command-line arguments and environment variables for Claude Code. **Show Agent Launch** shows what each agent starts with.
config.codex.enabled: Controls whether Codex is offered for new agents. Turning it off does not stop running agents.
config.codex.launch: Advanced: additional command-line arguments and environment variables for Codex. **Show Agent Launch** shows what each agent starts with.
config.antigravity.enabled: Controls whether Antigravity is offered for new agents. Turning it off does not stop running agents.
config.antigravity.launch: Advanced: additional command-line arguments and environment variables for Antigravity. **Show Agent Launch** shows what each agent starts with.
config.muse.enabled: Controls whether Muse Code is offered for new agents. Turning it off does not stop running agents.
config.muse.launch: Advanced: additional command-line arguments and environment variables for Muse Code. **Show Agent Launch** shows what each agent starts with.
config.opencode.enabled: Controls whether OpenCode is offered for new agents. Turning it off does not stop running agents.
config.opencode.launch: Advanced: additional command-line arguments and environment variables for OpenCode. **Show Agent Launch** shows what each agent starts with.
config.pi.enabled: Controls whether Pi is offered for new agents. Turning it off does not stop running agents.
config.pi.launch: Advanced: additional command-line arguments and environment variables for Pi. **Show Agent Launch** shows what each agent starts with.
config.launch.arguments: Additional command-line options, passed to the CLI exactly as written and in this order.
config.launch.environment: Environment variables for the CLI: a string sets one, `null` removes it, and `${env:NAME}` in a value reads the editor's environment.
config.custom: Your own CLIs, by ID, each started in a terminal of its own: `{ "my-cli": { "path": "my-cli", "launch": { "start": [], "resume": ["resume", "${sessionId}"] } } }`. An ID cannot be a built-in one: `claude`, `codex`, `agy`, `muse`, `opencode`, or `pi`.
config.custom.path: The program to run: a command on the PATH, or a file path. Required.
config.custom.launch: How the CLI starts: `start` for a new conversation, `resume` for a saved one, and `environment` for its environment variables.
config.custom.launch.start: Arguments for a new interactive conversation, passed exactly as written.
config.custom.launch.resume: Required: the arguments that resume an exact saved conversation. `${sessionId}` is replaced by its session ID and must appear.
config.home:
The Facade home is the folder for Facade's settings, agent history, and messages. Only agents in windows with the same Facade home can communicate with each other. The `FACADE_HOME` environment variable overrides the `~/.facade` default; a path here overrides both.

[Edit in facade.json](command:facade.openSettingsFile) to add your own CLIs or terminal programs. You also choose how each starts, what New Agent offers, the names it suggests, and whether YOLO is on.
config.home.pattern: The path must start with ~/ or be absolute.
config.movedPlain: Moved to facade.json. Run Facade Code: Open Settings to reach it.
